_comment: Home areas for the flasher's location step -- which settings a node subscribes to, NOT the mesh region tree pushed to the device. The two are different things and are not required to line up. 'id' is an internal handle with no meaning; the settings file is named by the 'settings' property and is never derived from the id. Zone geometry from https://regions.caboosey.net/regions/, simplified to ~220 m; 'counties' is their provenance. 'kind' drives rendering: states are always drawn, zones only under the pointer.
